title: Arctic Cat Snowmobiles Recalled by Textron Specialized Vehicles Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The handgrip can break, posing an injury hazard to the rider. Units: About 255.

title: Clean Republic Recalls Hill Topper Electric Bike Motor Controllers Due to Crash and Injury Hazards
summary: Water can enter the motor controller and cause it to accelerate on its own, posing a crash and injury hazard to the rider. Units: About 3,350.

title: Miller Fireworks Recalls Fireworks Due to Violation of Federal Standard; Explosion and Burn Hazards
summary: The recalled fireworks are overloaded with pyrotechnics intended to produce an audible effect, violating the federal regulatory requirements for this product. title: Rena Ware Recalls Nutrex Pressure Cookers Due to Burn Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled pressure cookers can discharge steam at lower pressures than intended, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 700.

title: Zebra Technologies Expands Recall of Power Supply Units for Thermal Printers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The power supply units can degrade and corrode over time when exposed to moisture and overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,370,000 (166,000 units were previously recalled in December 2016).

title: BMC Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: Variations in tire dimension, tire pressure, head set play and ride load, can result in insufficient space between the front wheel and downtube, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 430.

title: Polaris Recalls ACE 150 and Ranger 150 Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The front suspension lower ball joint can separate over time, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 5,900.

title: Off-Road Motorcycles Recalled by American Honda Due to Crash and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The clutch outer can break, posing crash and injury hazards. Units: About 3,200.

title: Xtava Recalls Allure Hair Dryers Due to Fire, Burn and Electrical Shock Hazards
summary: The hair dryer and power cord can overheat and catch on fire, posing fire, burn and electrical shock hazards. Units: About 235,000.

title: Koehler-Bright Star Recalls Flashlights Due to Explosion Hazard
summary: The flashlights are missing an encapsulation on a circuit board component which protects the flashlight from igniting an explosive environment, posing an injury hazard to the user or bystander. Units: About 7,500 (In addition, 200 were sold in Canada).

title: Harbor Freight Tools Recalls Handgun Safes Due to Serious Injury Hazard
summary: The handgun safes can open without the use of a key or combination upon impact and allow unintended access to the contents of the safe, posing a risk of serious injury to children and others. Units: About 25,000.

title: Vitamix Recalls Ascent and Venturist Series Blending Containers Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The containers can separate from the blade's base exposing the blades, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 105,000 (In addition, about 5,300 were sold in Canada).

title: Bobcat Company Recalls Utility Vehicles Due To Burn and Fire Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The utility vehicle's exhaust header pipe can crack, posing burn and fire hazards. Units: About 2,700.

title: Polaris Recalls Gravely Utility Vehicles Due To Fire and Burn Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The utility vehicle's exhaust header pipe can crack, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 2,100.

title: NEMO Equipment Recalls Stargaze Recliner Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The plastic joint supports attached to the legs of the chairs can break, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 7,500 (About 15,500 units were previously recalled in February 2018).

title: Core Health & Fitness Recalls Stairmaster Stepmill Exercise Equipment Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The steps can accelerate rapidly without input from the user, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 3,500.

title: PetSmart Recalls Strip Lights for Reptile Cages Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The strip light's fluorescent bulb can overheat causing the hood on the light fixture to ignite, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 23,000 (in addition, about 440 were sold in Canada).

title: BSN SPORTS Recalls Rubber Critter Toys Due to Violation of Federal Lead Paint Ban (Recall Alert)
summary: The orange and yellow surface paint on the rubber critter toys contains levels of lead that exceed the federal lead paint ban. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health issues. Units: About 31,200.

title: Cybex Recalls Weight-Lifting Equipment Due to Serious Injury Hazards
summary: The weight bar can fall, posing serious injury hazards to the user. Units: About 15,000.

title: Polaris Recalls RZR XP Turbo S Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: In the event of a high-speed rollover, the vehicle's rollover protection structure (ROPS) can fracture, providing inadequate protection during a rollover. Units: About 1,300.

title: American Landmaster Recalls Off-Road Utility Vehicles Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: Gas can leak from the utility vehicle's gas tank, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 1,500.

title: Manhattan Toy Recalls Toy Planes Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The rubber tires can separate from the wheels, posing a choking hazard for young children. Units: About 5,100 (In addition, about 930 were sold in Canada).

title: Vornado Air Reannounces Recall of Electric Space Heaters Following Report of Death; Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The electric space heater can overheat when in use, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 350,000 (This recall was first announced in April 2018).

title: Yamaha Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The passenger handgrips can come loose during operation of the snowmobile, increasing the risk that the passenger could lose balance and fall, resulting in severe injury. Units: About 120.

title: Confer Plastics Recalls Pool Step Systems Due to Entrapment and Drowning Hazard
summary: Children's limbs can become entrapped in the side openings of the step systems, posing a drowning hazard. Units: About 100,000 (In addition, about 2,100 were sold in Canada).
